ConsumerProfile.title: ConsumerProfile
ConsumerProfile.description: Authenticated NeighbourConnect user profile linked to the platform owner account, tracking selected role (CONSUMER or PROVIDER).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: User verified email address from Google Sign-In.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Google account.

neighborhood.description: Active GPS neighborhood selected by the user.

linkedAccountOwnerEmail.description: Platform owner account email to which this user profile is linked.

role.description: Selected marketplace role of the user.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ServiceProviderRegistration.title: ServiceProviderRegistration
ServiceProviderRegistration.description: Mandatory KYC Government ID and Professional Certification registration record for Service Providers.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registered service provider.

email.description: Verified Google email of the service provider.

fullName.description: Full legal or business name of the service provider.

professionCategory.description: Primary profession category key (e.g. ELECTRICIAN, PLUMBER, DOCTOR).

govIdType.description: Type of mandatory Government ID document submitted.

govIdDocumentVerified.description: Whether the Government ID document scan was attached and verified.

certificationTitle.description: Professional certification or trade license title.

issuingAuthority.description: Recognized board or authority that issued the certification.

certificationNumber.description: Alphanumeric registration or license certificate number.

baseVisitingFeeInr.description: Standard visiting and inspection fee in INR.

upiId.description: Validated UPI ID for 98% escrow payouts.

acceptsEmergencySos.description: Whether the provider accepts 24x7 emergency SOS dispatches.

linkedAccountOwnerEmail.description: Platform owner account email to which this provider is linked.

ConsumerBooking.title: ConsumerBooking
ConsumerBooking.description: Cloud-synced service booking created by an authenticated consumer and linked to the platform account.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the consumer who created the booking.

consumerEmail.description: Email address of the consumer who placed the booking.

linkedAccountOwnerEmail.description: Platform owner account email to which this booking is linked.

providerId.description: ID of the booked local professional.

providerName.description: Name of the booked local professional.

issueSummary.description: Description of the consumer service issue.

/consumers/{userId}.description: Stores authenticated user accounts and their selected role (CONSUMER or PROVIDER) linked to the NeighbourConnect owner account.

/service_providers/{userId}.description: Stores mandatory Government ID KYC and Professional Certification records for registered Service Providers.

/consumer_bookings/{bookingId}.description: Stores cloud-synced consumer service bookings linked to the consumer and platform owner account.
